Yeah a lot of games arent as good as we remember. For me in particular, mario 64 really isnt as intuitive or good as we all said it was. I had a hard time getting mario to go where i wanted him to. Its not the games fault though, its the joystick. That and the n64 tends to have input lag. For most games thats ok but mario 64 can get a little hard with its platforming so it has an effect on the experience.
